scripts.text:
[Aperture]
Hello there, adventurer.
I've been studying magic from all over Midgard to upgrade what I believe to be one of the greatest skills available to the acolyte class.
scripts.translation:
[光圈]
你好，冒險者。
我一直在研究米德加爾特各地的魔法，希望提升我認為最適合服事職業的強力技能之一。

scripts.text:
[Aperture]
I am the one and only Acolyte that has attained the Level 10 Warp Portal skill!
scripts.translation:
[光圈]
我是唯一一位把傳送之陣練到10級的服事！

scripts.text:
[Aperture]
That's right! And...
I promise you that I don't forget locations that I have already memorized.
One day I will level up my skills to warp to wherever I please~
scripts.translation:
[光圈]
沒錯！而且……
我保證，已經記住的地點絕不會忘。
總有一天，我要把傳送技能練到想去哪兒就去哪兒~

scripts.text:
[Aperture]
I am willing to warp you to the many locations that I have memorized for a small fee.
Would you like to use this service?
scripts.translation:
[光圈]
我可以收取少量費用，把你傳送到我記住的許多地點。
要使用這項服務嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 要

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不要

scripts.text:
[Aperture]
Where would you like to go to?
I wish you goodluck on your journey.
scripts.translation:
[光圈]
你想去哪裡？
祝你旅途順利。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aperture]
Come back when you need a warp.
scripts.translation:
[光圈]
需要傳送時再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Aperture]
I'm sorry, but you don't have
enough zeny for the Teleport
Service. The fee to teleport
to {0} is {1} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[光圈]
抱歉，你的 Zeny 不足，無法使用傳送服務。傳送到{0}需要{1} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Aperture]
Come back when you need a warp.
scripts.translation:
[光圈]
需要傳送時再來找我。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
{0}
I'm sorry, but you don't have
enough zeny for the Teleport
Service. The fee to teleport
to {1} is 1,800 zeny.
scripts.translation:
{0}
抱歉，你的 Zeny 不足，無法使用傳送服務。傳送到{1}需要1,800 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Primo d'Buffer]
Hello adventurer, you look like you are itching to get out there and save the world!
I can also tell that you haven't been blessed with '^6666ffVIP Status^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[普里莫·德·巴弗]
你好，冒險者！看起來你迫不及待想出去拯救世界了！
不過我看得出來，你還沒有^6666ffVIP資格^000000。

scripts.text:
[Primo d'Buffer]
Hello adventurer, you look like you are itching to get out there and save the world!
I can also tell that you have been blessed with '^007FFFVIP Status^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[普里莫·德·巴弗]
你好，冒險者！看起來你迫不及待想出去拯救世界了！
而且你已經獲得了^007FFFVIP資格^000000。

scripts.text:
[Primo d'Buffer]
My orders are to help out any Adventurer marked as VIP with special Buffs!
Currently I will give you ^ff0000+7 to all of your Stats for 30 minutes^000000 if you are VIP.
scripts.translation:
[普里莫·德·巴弗]
我的任務是為VIP冒險者提供特殊狀態加成！
只要你是VIP，我現在就能讓^ff0000所有屬性提高7點，持續30分鐘^000000。

scripts.text:
[Primo d'Buffer]
If you would like to be VIP, you can use WarpPortal to ^FF8C42Power-UP^000000 your game account with VIP Status. Of course there are many other advantages to being VIP, like higher EXP and Drop Rates, more Storage, and special buff NPCs like me!
Happy Journeys!
scripts.translation:
[普里莫·德·巴弗]
想成為VIP的話，可以通過WarpPortal為賬號^FF8C42升級^000000並開通VIP資格。VIP還有許多其他福利，例如提高經驗值與掉落率、增加倉庫空間，還有我這樣的特殊狀態加成服務！
祝你旅途愉快！

scripts.text:
[Primo d'Buffer]
That is awesome!
Here is +7 to all your stats for 30 minutes to help you on your journey. Just come back when you need to refill your stats!
scripts.translation:
[普里莫·德·巴弗]
太棒了！
這份全屬性+7、持續30分鐘的狀態加成能助你一臂之力。需要重新加成時，隨時回來找我！

scripts.text: You must wait for the timer to finish before you can hire a new mercenary.
scripts.translation: 必須等計時結束後，才能僱用新的傭兵。

scripts.text:
[Clearchus]
Greetings young adventurer! I represent the Midgardian Mercenary Mission.
scripts.translation:
[克利爾庫斯]
你好，年輕的冒險者！我代表米德加爾特傭兵團。

scripts.text:
[Clearchus]
We provide training to aspiring mercenaries by pairing them with adventurers such as yourself.
scripts.translation:
[克利爾庫斯]
我們會讓有志成為傭兵的人與像你這樣的冒險者組隊，藉此訓練他們。

scripts.text:
[Clearchus]
Our organization is 10,000 strong! Now let me see if you are registered for this service.
scripts.translation:
[克利爾庫斯]
我們組織有一萬名成員！讓我看看你有沒有登記使用這項服務。

scripts.text:
[Clearchus]
Unfortunately it appears that you are not VIP, please get VIP so that you can use this service. You can get a temporary VIP access by talking to Gramps at the Eden Group Headquarters.
scripts.translation:
[克利爾庫斯]
很遺憾，你似乎不是VIP。請先開通VIP才能使用這項服務。你可以去樂園團總部找老爺爺，申請臨時VIP資格。

scripts.text:
[Clearchus]
Vip is a very useful tool for adventurers to have, giving access to extra Kafra Services, discounted warps, exclusive content, and use of Primo d'Buffer. If an adventurer has full vip they even get an Exp, Drops, and storage boost!
scripts.translation:
[克利爾庫斯]
VIP對冒險者很有幫助，能享受額外的卡普拉服務、優惠傳送、專屬內容，還能使用普里莫·德·巴弗的服務。完整VIP資格還能提高經驗值和掉落率，並增加倉庫容量！

scripts.text:
[Clearchus]
Your name is on the list.
scripts.translation:
[克利爾庫斯]
名單上有你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Clearchus]
What kind of skill set are you looking for in a mercenary?
scripts.translation:
[克利爾庫斯]
你想僱用哪種技能型別的傭兵？

scripts.text: Swordsman
scripts.translation: 劍士

scripts.text: Archer
scripts.translation: 弓箭手

scripts.text: Lancer
scripts.translation: 槍兵

scripts.text:
[Clearchus]
I have just the mercenary in mind!
scripts.translation:
[克利爾庫斯]
我想到一位合適的傭兵了！

scripts.text:
[Clearchus]
Have fun now, ya hear?
scripts.translation:
[克利爾庫斯]
祝你玩得開心，聽見沒？

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Oh... I see from that look that you want me to work and give you Meat and Carrots...
Well my friend Izaac here has some Red Potions with him, but I only have some Carrots.
So I can trade you ^0000CC1 Carrot for 3 Jellopy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
哦……看你的表情，是想讓我幹活，然後給你肉和胡蘿蔔吧……
我朋友伊扎克有紅色藥水，我這裡只剩胡蘿蔔。
我可以用^0000CC1根胡蘿蔔^000000換3個傑勒比結晶。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
If you're interested in my offer, get me the Jellopies I mentioned.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
想接受的話，就把我說的傑勒比結晶拿來。

scripts.text: Carrots please.
scripts.translation: 給我胡蘿蔔

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Alright, let's see what ya got...
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
好，讓我看看你帶了什麼……

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Hmm, look dude, I said 3 Jellopies for 1 Carrot... got it?
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
聽著，我說的是3個傑勒比結晶換1根胡蘿蔔……明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Not too bad...
How many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
還不錯……
你想換多少？

scripts.text: As many as I can get, please.
scripts.translation: 請把我能換的都給我

scripts.text: I want to choose.
scripts.translation: 我想自己選

scripts.text: Never mind, I like my Jellopy.
scripts.translation: 算了，我還是留著傑勒比結晶

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
How many do you want?
^ff0000You have enough for up to {0} Carrots.^000000
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
你想換多少？
^ff0000你最多可以換{0}根胡蘿蔔。^000000

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Don't want to deal? Fair enough...
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
不想交易？也行……

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Dude, I said for every 3 Jellopy I'll give you 1 Carrot.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
我說過了，每3個傑勒比結晶換1根胡蘿蔔。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
Don't bother me if you don't want to trade.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
不想交易的話就別來煩我。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
You are overweight.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
你超重了。

scripts.text:
[Phelix]
There you go~! As I promised.
Try not to stuff yer face.
scripts.translation:
[菲利克斯]
給你~說好了的。
別一口氣全吃光啊。

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
Good day!
Have you collected any weird stuff from monsters?
I want things like Jellopy, Fluff, Shell, Feather of Birds, Tree Root, Worm Peelings, and Chrysalis.
I need those for something.
scripts.translation:
[伊扎克]
你好！
你有從魔物身上撿到什麼奇怪的東西嗎？
我想收傑勒比結晶、絨毛、貝殼、鳥羽、樹根、蟲皮和蛹。
我需要這些東西辦點事。

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
Of course, I won't ask you to give me that stuff for free. What if I traded the following for ^CC00001 Red Potion^000000:
^00CC005 Shell^000000
^0000CC10 Fluff^000000
^00CC0010 Jellopy^000000
^0000CC6 Tree Root^000000
^00CC001 Worm Peeling^000000
^0000CC7 Feather of Birds^000000
^00CC006 Chrysalis^000000
Sure!
scripts.translation: 好啊！

scripts.text: I think it's a rip-off!
scripts.translation: 這也太坑人了！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
So which items do
you want to bring me?
scripts.translation:
[伊扎克]
那麼，你想帶哪些物品給我？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
Sure~
No problem.

[伊扎克]
當然~
沒問題。

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
Hey, where's all
that {0} that
you promised me?
Give me {1}!
scripts.translation:
[伊扎克]
喂，你答應給我的{0}呢？
把{1}給我！

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
Okay, let me check
how much {0}
you have on you.
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[伊扎克]
好，讓我看看你帶了多少{0}。
嗯……

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
You have
a total of {0} {1}...
For all those, I can give you
a total of {2} Red Potion(s).
scripts.translation:
[伊扎克]
你一共有{0}個{1}……
這些都給我的話，我可以給你{2}瓶紅色藥水。

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
What do you say?
Do we have a deal?
scripts.translation:
[伊扎克]
怎麼樣？
成交嗎？

scripts.text: Deal.
scripts.translation: 成交

scripts.text: No deal.
scripts.translation: 不成交

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
Huh~
Alright.
Though are
{0} more useful
to an adventurer like you?
scripts.translation:
[伊扎克]
哈~
好吧。
不過，對你這樣的冒險者來說，{0}不是更有用嗎？

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
You are overweight.
scripts.translation:
[伊扎克]
你超重了。

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
There you go!
Check how many {0}
I've given you, it should be good.
Thanks, that was a good deal~
scripts.translation:
[伊扎克]
給你！
數數我給了你多少{0}，看看對不對。
謝謝，合作愉快~

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
A rip-off...?
If you check the market value
of the items being traded, I'm actually the one getting
ripped off here.
scripts.translation:
[伊扎克]
坑人……？
你去看看這些物品的市價就知道了，明明是我吃虧才對。

scripts.text:
[Izaac]
Alright, No problem.
But come back to me if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[伊扎克]
好吧，沒問題。
改變主意的話再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Eve Natalia]
So I'm in town for a while to see if I can strike up some commerce with MVP hunters!
I'm willing to take some MVP gear and give you these upgrade Certificates I have in exchange;
if things go well enough I'll open up further business opportunities!
scripts.translation:
[伊芙·娜塔莉婭]
我會在城裡待一陣子，看看能不能和MVP獵人做點生意！
我願意收購一些MVP裝備，用手頭的強化證書交換；如果合作順利，以後還會有更多交易機會！

scripts.text:
[Eve Natalia]
So do you have any of the gears I'm looking for to get some random Safe to 7 Certificates?
scripts.translation:
[伊芙·娜塔莉婭]
你有我需要的裝備嗎？我可以給你隨機的安全精煉至+7券。

scripts.text: What gear?
scripts.translation: 什麼裝備？

scripts.text: Yes I am!
scripts.translation: 有

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了

[Eve Natalia]

scripts.text:
[Eve Natalia]
I'm going to ask you which piece of gear you want to trade in, please verify that the 1st one in your inventory is one you want to give up.
^CC0000So if it is carded, upgraded, enchanted etc, you should put it in storage before we continue.^000000
scripts.translation:
[伊芙·娜塔莉婭]
我會問你想換哪件裝備。請確認物品欄第一件就是你要交出的裝備。
^CC0000如果裝備插了卡片、經過精煉或附魔等，請先放進倉庫再繼續。^000000

scripts.text: Wait a minute
scripts.translation: 等一下

scripts.translation: 尼德霍格的影子裝束 4

scripts.translation: 恐懼戰甲 2

scripts.text: Diabolus Boots 2
scripts.translation: 恐懼戰靴 2

scripts.translation: 恐懼斗篷 4

scripts.text:
[Eve Natalia]
I see you have {0} {1}.
So do you want to trade the 1st one in your inventory for ^00CC00{2} Random Safe to 7 Certificates^000000?
Tell me '1' if you do, or '0' to cancel.
scripts.translation:
[伊芙·娜塔莉婭]
我看到你有{0}個{1}。
你想用物品欄裡的第一件交換^00CC00{2}張隨機+7券^000000嗎？同意就說“1”，取消就說“0”。

scripts.text:
[Eve Natalia]
It is a 0 or 1, it can't be that difficult.
scripts.translation:
[伊芙·娜塔莉婭]
只能輸入0或1，這有那麼難嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eve Natalia]
It's best to be sure before trading, have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[伊芙·娜塔莉婭]
交易前最好確認清楚。祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Eve Natalia]
You don't even have 1... stop wasting my time.
scripts.translation:
[伊芙·娜塔莉婭]
你連一件都沒有……別浪費我的時間。

scripts.text:
[Eve Natalia]
Oh perfect, you get ^CC0000{0}^000000 Safe to 7 Certificates!
scripts.translation:
[伊芙·娜塔莉婭]
太好了！你獲得了^CC0000{0}^000000張+7券！

scripts.text:
[Eve Natalia]
Fair enough, if you have business with me in the future don't be shy!
scripts.translation:
[伊芙·娜塔莉婭]
好啊，以後有事找我儘管開口！

scripts.text: You're carrying too many items right now.
scripts.translation: 你現在攜帶的物品太多了。

How many {0} do you want?
I can give you up to 60.
Type 0 to cancel.

[交易機器]
你要兌換多少個{0}？
最多可以兌換60個。
輸入0取消。

scripts.text:
[Trader Machine]
Cancelled.
scripts.translation:
[交易機器]
已取消。

[Trader Machine]
I said only 60 max.
scripts.translation:
[交易機器]
我說了，最多隻能兌換60個。

scripts.text:
[Trader Machine]
That's a total of {0} {1}.
Is this correct?
scripts.translation:
[交易機器]
總共是{0}個{1}。
確認嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, give them to me!
